title: irlpls Order (status) (DRAFT)
description: The Order resource: returned by POST /orders (202, or 200 when already delivered), GET /orders/{id} and POST /orders/{id}/cancel. States are the Job words, so a router needs no per-provider status map. Draft: docs/protocol/PROTOCOL-DRAFT.md.

reason_code.description: Why a failed order failed. Known values: rejected, cancelled, expired, undeliverable, provider_error. Unknown values are unsupported, never re-mapped.

provider_status.description: The provider's own status word, as sent.

request_sha256.description: Hash of the request the provider priced for this order: the accepted quote's request_sha256, or, for a direct order, SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 form of the order's request. Every receipt carries it; the client checks it against the request it sent.

total.description: The amount the provider will charge for this order. Never more than the accepted offer's total or the direct order's max_total, in the same currency.

progress.description: ordered: the request's quantity. delivered: items in the delivery so far (a live reading may return more items than quantity, one per observed property).

delivery.description: Always present; GET answers in every state (items [] before the first).
Inline when the order completed synchronously (a live reading).

order_list.description: GET {endpoint}/orders?client_reference=<ref>: this client's orders carrying that client_reference, newest first (recovery after the idempotency window).

webhook_event.description: Thin event POSTed to the order's webhook.url (Standard Webhooks headers). The receiver re-reads the order before acting.

order_url.description: MUST equal {endpoint}/orders/{order_id} exactly; the receiver compares it as a string with the endpoint it ordered from.
